Apply a function on each pair of features

Source: R/AllGenerics.R
pairwiseApply.Rd

Apply a function on each pair of features

Usage

pairwiseApply(X, ...)

Arguments

X

input object

...

additional arguments

Value

a list containing the output of applying the function to each feature pair. See ?base::mapply()

Examples

web <- randomWeb(10)
#>                       sample_id repeated group_ab subtype     score_a
#> anansi_ID_sample_1_1   sample_1    rep_1        b       z -0.63710166
#> anansi_ID_sample_2_1   sample_2    rep_1        a       x  0.74632635
#> anansi_ID_sample_3_1   sample_3    rep_1        a       y  1.01846753
#> anansi_ID_sample_4_1   sample_4    rep_1        a       z  0.24092295
#> anansi_ID_sample_5_1   sample_5    rep_1        b       x  0.20998094
#> anansi_ID_sample_6_1   sample_6    rep_1        a       y  1.97638942
#> anansi_ID_sample_7_1   sample_7    rep_1        b       z -0.14150444
#> anansi_ID_sample_8_1   sample_8    rep_1        b       z  2.69307575
#> anansi_ID_sample_9_1   sample_9    rep_1        b       x -1.45569611
#> anansi_ID_sample_10_1 sample_10    rep_1        b       z  0.07667912
#>                          score_b    score_c
#> anansi_ID_sample_1_1   1.5548854  1.2848823
#> anansi_ID_sample_2_1  -0.6257260 -2.1422504
#> anansi_ID_sample_3_1  -1.1611169 -0.3039372
#> anansi_ID_sample_4_1  -0.7328777 -0.7173421
#> anansi_ID_sample_5_1  -0.1246043 -0.4457581
#> anansi_ID_sample_6_1  -1.1253530 -1.1119900
#> anansi_ID_sample_7_1   0.4904111 -0.1787959
#> anansi_ID_sample_8_1   1.6677152  0.7971751
#> anansi_ID_sample_9_1  -0.6412408  0.6582043
#> anansi_ID_sample_10_1  0.6439974  0.3165413

# For each feature pair, was the value for x higher than the value for y?
pairwiseApply(
    X = web,
    FUN = function(x, y) x > y,
    MoreArgs = NULL, SIMPLIFY = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE
    )

# Run cor.test() on each pair of features
pairwiseApply(
    X = web,
    FUN = function(x, y) cor.test(x, y),
    MoreArgs = NULL, SIMPLIFY = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE
)
